provenance_label: Live run on a local kind cluster

issue.symptom: The rollout is stuck: new Pods run with zero restarts but never become Ready; the release never goes live.

fault_proof.name: new Pods run but are not Ready
fault_proof.detail: Pods with the /ready probe are Running, not Ready

observations.text: New storefront Pod is running and healthy (liveness /healthz 200) but its readiness probe targets /ready, which the app does not implement (404). The app's readiness endpoint is /readyz per docs/operations.md.
evidence: events: Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 404 on /ready

agent_conclusion.root_cause: The storefront Deployment's readiness probe targeted /ready, an endpoint the application does not implement (404). The documented readiness endpoint is /readyz, which returns 200 once configuration is loaded and the cache is warmed. The probe path was corrected to /readyz.
agent_conclusion.summary: Fixed k8s/deployment.yaml readinessProbe.httpGet.path from /ready to /readyz and applied it. Rollout completed with 2/2 Pods ready; verified /readyz and /healthz return 200 through the storefront Service.
evidence: events: Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 404 on /ready
http_check /readyz via storefront Service returned 200 ready
